title: Factorial diagnosis of prepared-solve reanchor history and IMS residual closure
method: For each variant use one MODFLOW6 prepared solve and exactly the admitted application-service iteration order: publish one exact local tangent, solve once, evaluate the exact nonlinear residual, then reanchor HCOF/RHS for the next outer coupling iteration.
preregistered_diagnostic_gate: NO_UR_R1E14 must achieve MODFLOW convergence and exact nonlinear residual <=1e-12 m/day
NO_UR_R1E14 head must be within 1e-10 m of the closed-form root
the other three variants are characterization points and are not retuned after observation
interpretation_logic: Difference DEFAULT_R1E15 versus NO_UR_R1E15 isolates nonlinear under-relaxation history at fixed inner residual closure.
Difference NO_UR_R1E15 versus NO_UR_R1E14 isolates the inner linear residual certification floor after the physical nonlinear root has been reached.
If NO_UR_R1E14 closes, the DSW-09 failure is explained by two numerically distinct effects rather than coupling algebra.
forbidden: do not change the original DSW-09 preregistered gate
do not infer that disabling under-relaxation or choosing rclose=1e-14 is a production recommendation
